example_sentence: Bu konuda farklı bir fikrim var.
example_translation: I have a different opinion on this topic.
notes: Front vowel word: suffixes use -ler. 'Fikir' drops the second vowel when suffixed: fikrim, fikri.

example_translation: I completely agree with you.
notes: Takes dative case: birine katılmak (to agree with someone). Back vowel harmony.

example_translation: I oppose this decision.
notes: Compound verb: karşı (against) + çıkmak (to come out). Takes dative case.

example_translation: We support this project.
notes: Derived from 'destek' (support) + -lemek verb suffix. Front vowel harmony.

example_translation: I am not afraid of criticizing the government.
notes: From 'eleştiri' (criticism). Front vowel word throughout.

example_translation: I want to suggest a solution.
notes: Related noun: öneri (suggestion). Front vowel harmony throughout.

example_translation: We discussed this topic for hours.
notes: Reciprocal verb form with -ış suffix. Can mean both 'discuss' and 'argue' depending on context.

example_translation: You are completely right about this.
notes: From 'hak' (right, justice) + -lı suffix. Opposite: haksız (wrong, unjust).

example_translation: This criticism is completely unjust.
notes: From 'hak' (right) + -sız (without) suffix. Opposite of 'haklı'.

example_translation: You should defend your own ideas.
notes: Back vowel word. Also used in legal context: avukat müvekkilini savunur.

example_translation: I accept my mistake.
notes: Compound verb: kabul (acceptance) + etmek (to do). Common pattern with Arabic loanwords.

example_translation: I had to reject the offer.
notes: From 'ret' (rejection) + etmek. Note consonant doubling: ret → reddetmek.

example_translation: Would you share your thoughts?
notes: From 'düşünmek' (to think) + -ce noun suffix. Front vowel word.

example_translation: It is very hard to convince him.
notes: Compound verb with Arabic loanword 'ikna'. Takes accusative: birini ikna etmek.

example_translation: You are definitely right about this.
notes: From 'kesin' (certain) + -likle. Used to strongly agree or emphasize.

example_translation: Undoubtedly this is the best solution.
notes: From 'şüphe' (doubt) + -siz (without). Front vowel word.

example_translation: I think this approach is wrong.
notes: Also used as a noun meaning 'mistake'. Back vowel word.

example_translation: What you said is completely correct.
notes: Multiple meanings: as adjective 'correct/true', as postposition 'towards' (with dative).

example_translation: This is a very important topic.
notes: From 'önem' (importance) + -li suffix. Front vowel word.

example_sentence: Bu kelimenin birden fazla anlamı var.
example_translation: This word has more than one meaning.
notes: Related: anlamak (to understand), anlamlı (meaningful), anlamsız (meaningless).

example_translation: I study law at university.
notes: Front vowel word: üniversitede, üniversiteler. Locative suffix -de (not -da).

example_sentence: Yarın çok zor bir sınavım var.
example_translation: I have a very difficult exam tomorrow.
notes: Back vowel word. Related: sınava girmek (to take an exam), sınavı geçmek (to pass an exam).

example_translation: What department are you studying in?
notes: Front vowel word. Also means 'chapter' (of a book) or 'episode' (of a show).

example_sentence: Bu araştırma çok değerli sonuçlar verdi.
example_translation: This research produced very valuable results.
notes: From 'araştırmak' (to research). Back vowel word throughout.

example_translation: I graduated from university last year.
notes: Compound verb. Takes ablative: bir yerden mezun olmak (to graduate from somewhere).

example_translation: I am taking five courses this semester.
notes: Front vowel word: dersler, derste. 'Ders çalışmak' means to study.

example_translation: I need to finish my homework.
notes: Front vowel word. 'Ödev yapmak' (to do homework) is the standard collocation.

example_translation: I got a good grade on the math exam.
notes: Back vowel word: notlar, notum. Means both 'grade' and 'note' depending on context.

example_translation: A very successful student.
notes: From 'başarı' (success) + -lı. Opposite: başarısız (unsuccessful).

example_translation: I applied for a scholarship.
notes: Takes dative: bir yere başvurmak. Related noun: başvuru (application).

example_translation: The education system should change.
notes: Front vowel word. 'Eğitim almak' (to receive education/training).

example_translation: I receive a scholarship from the government.
notes: Back vowel word: burslar. 'Burs kazanmak' (to win a scholarship).

example_translation: The registration dates have been announced.
notes: Back vowel word. 'Kayıt olmak' (to register), 'kayıt yaptırmak' (to enroll).

example_translation: I will receive my diploma next month.
notes: Back vowel word due to final 'a': diplomalar. Possessive: diplomam, diploman.

example_translation: His academic achievement is very high.
notes: Mixed vowels but behaves as front vowel word for suffixes: akademikler.

example_translation: I am studying at the library.
notes: Front vowel word: kütüphanede, kütüphaneler. Originally from Arabic.

example_translation: I will attend an international conference.
notes: Back vowel for suffix purposes: konferanslar. 'Konferans vermek' (to give a lecture).

example_translation: I will submit my thesis next month.
notes: Front vowel word: tezler, tezim. 'Tez savunmak' (to defend a thesis).

example_translation: This semester was very busy.
notes: Front vowel word: dönemler, dönemde. Also means 'era' or 'period' in general usage.

example_sentence: Öğretim görevlisi dersi çok iyi anlatıyor.
example_translation: The lecturer explains the lesson very well.
notes: Compound noun with possessive suffix: görevli + -si. Front vowel harmony.

example_translation: I need to buy a new computer.
notes: Literally 'information counter': bilgi (information) + sayar (counts). Back vowel suffixes.

example_translation: The internet connection is very slow.
notes: Front vowel word: internette, internetler. 'İnternete bağlanmak' (to connect to the internet).

example_translation: I downloaded this app to my phone.
notes: From 'uygulamak' (to apply/implement). Back vowel word: uygulamalar.

example_translation: I forgot my password, I need to reset it.
notes: Front vowel word: şifreler, şifremi. 'Şifre koymak' (to set a password).

example_translation: I downloaded the file to my computer.
notes: Also means 'to lower' or 'to bring down' in non-tech contexts. Front vowel word.

example_translation: I uploaded the photos to the cloud.
notes: From 'yük' (load) + -lemek. Also means 'to load' or 'to install software'.

example_translation: The computer's hardware should be updated.
notes: From 'donanmak' (to be equipped). Opposite of 'yazılım' (software).

example_sentence: Bu yazılımı geliştirmek iki yıl sürdü.
example_translation: Developing this software took two years.
notes: From 'yazılmak' (to be written). Back vowel word: yazılımlar.

example_translation: Backing up data is very important.
notes: Front vowel word: veriler. 'Veri tabanı' (database), 'veri analizi' (data analysis).

example_translation: I cannot connect to the wireless network.
notes: Also means 'web' or 'net' literally. Back vowel word: ağlar. Short word, note buffer consonant: ağa, ağı.

example_translation: The screen resolution is very high.
notes: Back vowel word: ekranlar. 'Dokunmatik ekran' (touchscreen).

example_translation: Don't forget to update the phone.
notes: From 'güncel' (current/up-to-date) + -lemek. Related noun: güncelleme (update).

example_translation: Artificial intelligence is changing our lives.
notes: Compound: yapay (artificial) + zekâ (intelligence). Very current topic in Turkish media.

example_translation: I will attend the online meeting.
notes: Turkish neologism replacing English 'online'. Opposite: çevrim dışı (offline).

example_translation: We cannot access the site because the server is down.
notes: From 'sunmak' (to offer/present) + -ucu agent suffix. Also means 'presenter/host'.

example_translation: I sent the file by email.
notes: Back vowel word: dosyalar. Also means 'folder' in physical context.

example_translation: I closed my social media account.
notes: Also means 'bill' (at restaurant) and 'calculation'. Consonant change: hesap → hesabı.

example_translation: Press the Enter key.
notes: Back vowel word: tuşlar. 'Tuş takımı' (keyboard/keypad).

example_translation: The internet connection was lost.
notes: From 'bağlanmak' (to connect). Back vowel word: bağlantılar.

example_translation: Protecting the environment is everyone's duty.
notes: Front vowel word: çevreler. Also means 'neighborhood' or 'circle (of people)'.

example_sentence: Hava kirliliği büyük şehirlerde ciddi bir sorun.
example_translation: Air pollution is a serious problem in big cities.
notes: From 'kirli' (dirty) + -lik. Front vowel word: kirlilikler.

example_translation: Climate change is affecting the whole world.
notes: Front vowel word: iklimler. 'İklim değişikliği' (climate change) is a common compound.

example_translation: Please put it in the recycling bin.
notes: Compound: geri (back) + dönüşüm (transformation). Front vowel suffixes.

example_translation: I like spending time in nature.
notes: Back vowel word: doğalar, doğada. 'Doğal' (natural) is the adjective form.

example_translation: We should invest in renewable energy sources.
notes: Front vowel word: enerjiler. 'Güneş enerjisi' (solar energy), 'rüzgâr enerjisi' (wind energy).

example_sentence: Küresel ısınma buzulların erimesine neden oluyor.
example_translation: Global warming is causing glaciers to melt.
notes: Compound: küresel (global) + ısınma (warming). Scientific/media term.

example_translation: We need to reduce plastic waste.
notes: Back vowel word: atıklar. 'Atık su' (wastewater), 'tıbbi atık' (medical waste).

example_translation: Forest fires are increasing every summer.
notes: Back vowel word: ormanlar, ormanda. 'Yağmur ormanı' (rainforest).

example_translation: We should reduce energy consumption.
notes: From 'tüketmek' (to consume). Front vowel word: tüketimler. Related: tüketici (consumer).

example_translation: Sustainable development is very important.
notes: From 'sürdürmek' (to sustain) + -ülebilir (ability suffix). Long but regular suffixation.

example_translation: Greenhouse gas emissions should be reduced.
notes: Compound: sera (greenhouse) + gazı (its gas, with possessive). Scientific term.

example_translation: Many animal species are becoming extinct.
notes: 'Nesli tükenmek üzere olan' means 'endangered'. 'Nesil' drops vowel: nesli.

example_translation: We should make an effort to protect nature.
notes: Back vowel word. Related: koruma (protection), korunan (protected).

example_translation: Drought is negatively affecting agriculture.
notes: From 'kurak' (dry/arid) + -lık. Back vowel word: kuraklıklar.

example_translation: There was a flood after the heavy rain.
notes: Front vowel word: seller, selde. 'Sel baskını' (flood disaster).

example_translation: Turkey is located in an earthquake zone.
notes: Front vowel word: depremler. Very relevant vocabulary for Turkey. 'Deprem bölgesi' (earthquake zone).

example_translation: We should bring carbon emissions down to zero.
notes: Front vowel word: emisyonlar. 'Karbon emisyonu' (carbon emission).

example_translation: Art enriches life.
notes: Back vowel word: sanatlar. Consonant change: sanat → sanatı (not sanadı). 'Sanatçı' (artist).

example_translation: I like listening to classical music.
notes: Front vowel word: müzikler. 'Müzik aleti' (musical instrument), 'müzisyen' (musician).

example_translation: Shall we go to the cinema this evening?
notes: Back vowel suffixes due to final 'a': sinemalar, sinemada. Also means 'cinema' as art form.

example_translation: I love Turkish literature.
notes: Back vowel word for suffixes: edebiyatlar. Arabic origin.

example_translation: This painting is very impressive.
notes: Front vowel word: resimler. 'Resim yapmak' (to paint/draw), 'ressam' (painter).

example_translation: I bought a ticket for the theater.
notes: Back vowel word: tiyatrolar. 'Tiyatro oyunu' (theater play).

example_translation: A new exhibition opened at the museum.
notes: Front vowel word: sergiler. 'Sergi açmak' (to open an exhibition).

example_translation: The singer came on stage.
notes: Front vowel word: sahneler. 'Sahneye çıkmak' (to go on stage), 'sahne almak' (to perform).

example_translation: The director of this film is very famous.
notes: From 'yönetmek' (to manage/direct) + -men agent suffix. Front vowel word.

example_sentence: Bu eser on sekizinci yüzyıldan kalma.
example_translation: This work is from the eighteenth century.
notes: Front vowel word: eserler. Used for literary, artistic, and musical works. 'Başyapıt' is 'masterpiece'.

example_translation: I want to attend the film festival.
notes: Back vowel word: festivaller. 'Festival düzenlemek' (to organize a festival).

example_translation: This tradition has continued for centuries.
notes: Front vowel word: gelenekler. 'Geleneksel' (traditional).

example_translation: There is a beautiful sculpture in the park.
notes: Front vowel word: heykeller. 'Heykeltıraş' (sculptor).

example_sentence: Bu beste çok güzel bir melodi içeriyor.
example_translation: This composition contains a very beautiful melody.
notes: Front vowel word: besteler. 'Besteci' or 'bestekâr' (composer).

example_translation: I finished this novel in one night.
notes: Back vowel word: romanlar. 'Romancı' (novelist). Orhan Pamuk is Turkey's Nobel-winning novelist.

example_translation: I really love Nâzım Hikmet's poems.
notes: Front vowel word: şiirler. 'Şair' (poet). Poetry has deep roots in Turkish culture.

example_translation: The film reviews were generally negative.
notes: Front vowel word: eleştiriler. 'Eleştirmen' (critic).

example_translation: The audience gave a standing ovation.
notes: From 'seyir' (watching) + -ci agent suffix. Front vowel word: seyirciler.

example_translation: Our friendship has been going on for ten years.
notes: From 'arkadaş' (friend) + -lık abstract noun suffix. Back vowel word.

example_translation: I trust you completely.
notes: Takes dative: birine güvenmek. Related: güven (trust), güvenilir (trustworthy).

example_translation: Our relationship is very healthy.
notes: Front vowel word: ilişkiler. Can refer to romantic or general relationships.

example_translation: They broke up after a two-year relationship.
notes: Reflexive form of 'ayırmak' (to separate). Also means 'to leave' a place.

example_translation: We are getting married next summer.
notes: From 'ev' (house) + -lenmek. Takes instrumental: biriyle evlenmek (to marry someone).

example_translation: We got engaged last month.
notes: From 'nişan' (engagement) + -lanmak reflexive. 'Nişanlı' (fiancé/fiancée).

example_translation: There is no point in being jealous of him.
notes: Takes accusative: birini kıskanmak. Related: kıskançlık (jealousy), kıskanç (jealous).

example_translation: I missed you a lot.
notes: Takes accusative: birini özlemek. Very common expression. Related: özlem (longing).

example_translation: They made up after the fight.
notes: Reciprocal form with -ış. Related: barış (peace). Takes instrumental: biriyle barışmak.

example_translation: Loyalty is very important in a relationship.
notes: Arabic origin. Back vowel word: sadakatler. 'Sadık' (loyal/faithful).

example_translation: I need an understanding partner.
notes: From 'anlamak' (to understand). 'Anlayışlı' (understanding/empathetic) as adjective.

example_translation: Mutual respect is the foundation of a relationship.
notes: Back vowel word: saygılar. 'Saygılı' (respectful), 'saygısız' (disrespectful).

example_translation: Someone I trusted deceived me.
notes: Causative form of 'aldanmak' (to be deceived). Takes accusative: birini aldatmak.

example_translation: Good communication is the key to every relationship.
notes: From 'iletmek' (to convey). Front vowel word: iletişimler.

example_translation: Your support was very important during hard days.
notes: Front vowel word: destekler. 'Destek olmak' (to be supportive), 'destek vermek' (to give support).

example_translation: One needs to make sacrifices for family.
notes: From 'fedakâr' (self-sacrificing) + -lık. 'Fedakârlık yapmak' (to make a sacrifice).

example_translation: We share everything with each other.
notes: Reciprocal of 'pay' (share). Takes instrumental: biriyle paylaşmak. Also used for social media sharing.

example_translation: Chatting with him/her is very enjoyable.
notes: Front vowel word: sohbetler. 'Sohbet etmek' (to chat). Consonant change: sohbet → sohbeti.

example_translation: Did you watch the morning news?
notes: Front vowel word: haberler. 'Haber vermek' (to inform), 'haber bülteni' (news bulletin).

example_translation: I read the newspaper every morning.
notes: Front vowel word: gazeteler. 'Gazeteci' (journalist). From Italian 'gazzetta'.

example_translation: I spend a lot of time on social media.
notes: Compound from loanwords. 'Sosyal medya hesabı' (social media account).

example_translation: The live broadcast starts at eight.
notes: From 'yaymak' (to spread). Back vowel word: yayınlar. 'Canlı yayın' (live broadcast).

example_sentence: Muhabir olay yerinden canlı yayın yaptı.
example_translation: The reporter did a live broadcast from the scene.
notes: Front vowel word: muhabirler. Arabic origin. 'Savaş muhabiri' (war correspondent).

example_translation: The commercials on television are very boring.
notes: Back vowel word: reklamlar. 'Reklam yapmak' (to advertise). From French 'réclame'.

example_translation: Turkish TV series are very popular around the world.
notes: Front vowel word: diziler. Turkish dizis are a major cultural export. Also means 'series/row'.

example_translation: I like watching nature documentaries.
notes: From 'belge' (document) + -sel (related to). Front vowel word: belgeseller.

example_translation: Did you read today's headlines?
notes: Front vowel word: manşetler. From French 'manchette'. 'Manşet olmak' (to make headlines).

example_translation: We did an interview with a famous actor.
notes: From French 'reportage'. Back vowel word: röportajlar. 'Röportaj yapmak' (to conduct an interview).

example_translation: I wrote a comment under the news.
notes: Back vowel word: yorumlar. 'Yorum yapmak' (to comment/interpret), 'yorumcu' (commentator).

example_sentence: Sosyal medyada bir milyon takipçisi var.
example_translation: He/she has one million followers on social media.
notes: From 'takip' (following) + -çi agent suffix. Back vowel: takipçiler.

example_translation: Your last post was liked a lot.
notes: From 'paylaşmak' (to share). Back vowel word: paylaşımlar. Social media term.

example_translation: The press conference will be held tomorrow.
notes: From 'basmak' (to print/press). 'Basın özgürlüğü' (press freedom), 'basın toplantısı' (press conference).

example_translation: This topic stayed on the agenda for days.
notes: Front vowel word: gündemler. 'Gündemde olmak' (to be on the agenda/trending).

example_translation: Public opinion reacted to this decision.
notes: Compound: kamu (public) + oyu (its vote/opinion). 'Kamuoyu yoklaması' (public opinion poll).

example_translation: It is one of the biggest broadcasting companies.
notes: From 'yayın' (publication/broadcast) + -cı agent suffix. Back vowel: yayıncılar.

example_translation: I write a column every week.
notes: Compound: köşe (corner) + yazısı (its writing). 'Köşe yazarı' (columnist).

example_translation: Producing quality content is important.
notes: Front vowel word: içerikler. 'İçerik üretici' (content creator). Very common in digital media.

example_sentence: Türkiye'de futbol çok popüler bir spor.
example_translation: Football is a very popular sport in Turkey.
notes: Back vowel word: futbollar. Turkey has passionate football fans. 'Futbolcu' (football player).

example_translation: I train every day.
notes: From French 'entraînement'. Back vowel word: antrenmanlar. 'Antrenman yapmak' (to train).

example_translation: I came first in the swimming competition.
notes: From 'yarışmak' (to compete). Back vowel word: yarışmalar.

example_translation: Our team became champion this year.
notes: Back vowel word: şampiyonlar. 'Şampiyonluk' (championship). From French 'champion'.

example_sentence: Bu akşam çok önemli bir maç var.
example_translation: There is a very important match this evening.
notes: Back vowel word: maçlar. From English 'match'. 'Maç izlemek' (to watch a match).

example_translation: The referee made a controversial decision.
notes: Front vowel word: hakemler. Arabic origin. Very commonly discussed in Turkish football culture.

example_translation: The score of the match was 2-1.
notes: Back vowel word: skorlar. From English 'score'. 'Skor tablosu' (scoreboard).

example_translation: The stadium was full of fans.
notes: From 'taraf' (side) + -tar (supporter suffix). Back vowel: taraftarlar. Passionate in Turkish culture.

example_translation: We scored a goal in the last minute.
notes: Back vowel word: goller. 'Gol atmak' (to score a goal). From English 'goal'.

example_sentence: Haftada üç gün spor salonuna gidiyorum.
example_translation: I go to the gym three days a week.
notes: Compound: spor + salonu (its hall, with possessive). Back vowel word.

example_translation: I go running every morning.
notes: From 'koşmak' (to run). Back vowel word: koşular. 'Koşu bandı' (treadmill).

example_translation: Swimming is my favorite sport.
notes: From 'yüzmek' (to swim). Front vowel word. 'Yüzme havuzu' (swimming pool).

example_translation: I really like playing basketball.
notes: Back vowel word: basketbollar. Second most popular sport in Turkey after football.

example_translation: He couldn't play for two months due to injury.
notes: From 'sakat' (injured/disabled) + -lık. Back vowel word: sakatlıklar.

example_translation: She won a gold medal at the Olympics.
notes: Back vowel word: madalyalar. 'Altın madalya' (gold medal), 'gümüş madalya' (silver medal).

example_sentence: Teknik direktör yeni bir strateji denedi.
example_translation: The head coach tried a new strategy.
notes: Standard term in football. Front vowel word: teknik direktörler.

example_translation: The score was 1-0 at halftime.
notes: Compound: devre (half/period) + arası (its interval). Sports term.

example_sentence: Süper Lig'de bu hafta çok heyecanlı maçlar var.
example_translation: There are very exciting matches in the Super League this week.
notes: Front vowel word: ligler. 'Süper Lig' is the top Turkish football league.

example_sentence: Düzenli egzersiz sağlık için çok önemli.
example_translation: Regular exercise is very important for health.
notes: Front vowel word: egzersizler. 'Egzersiz yapmak' (to exercise). From French 'exercice'.

example_sentence: Bu tarifte ne kadar tuz kullanılıyor?
example_translation: How much salt is used in this recipe?
notes: Front vowel word: tarifler. Also means 'description/directions'. 'Yemek tarifi' (food recipe).

example_translation: I am cooking dinner.
notes: Causative of 'pişmek' (to be cooked). Front vowel word. General term for cooking.

example_translation: I fried the potatoes.
notes: Causative of 'kızarmak' (to become fried/browned). Back vowel word.

example_translation: I boiled the water and added the pasta.
notes: Causative of 'kaynamak' (to boil, intransitive). Back vowel word.

example_translation: I finely chopped the onions.
notes: Back vowel word. 'İnce doğramak' (to chop finely), 'küp küp doğramak' (to dice).

example_translation: Stir the soup continuously.
notes: Causative of 'karışmak'. Also means 'to confuse'. Back vowel word.

example_translation: A lot of spices are used in Turkish cuisine.
notes: Back vowel word: baharatlar. Arabic origin. Turkish cuisine uses cumin, red pepper, sumac extensively.

example_translation: I prepared all the ingredients.
notes: Front vowel word: malzemeler. Used for both cooking ingredients and general materials.

example_translation: I put the cake in the oven.
notes: Back vowel word: fırınlar. Double meaning: 'oven' (at home) and 'bakery' (shop). 'Fırında pişirmek' (to bake).

example_translation: I heated the pan and added oil.
notes: Back vowel word: tavalar. 'Tava balık' (pan-fried fish) is a popular dish.

example_translation: I cooked soup in a big pot.
notes: Front vowel word: tencereler. 'Düdüklü tencere' (pressure cooker).

example_translation: I kneaded the dough and left it to rest.
notes: Back vowel word: hamurlar. 'Hamur işi' (pastry/baked goods), 'hamur açmak' (to roll out dough).

example_translation: I grated the cheese.
notes: From 'rende' (grater) + -lemek. Front vowel word.

example_translation: I turned off the stove and moved the pot aside.
notes: Causative of 'sönmek' (to go out). Front vowel word. Used for stove, fire, lights.

example_translation: Serve the food hot.
notes: Compound verb: servis (service) + yapmak (to do). 'Servis tabağı' (serving plate).

example_sentence: Yemeğe çeşni katmak için limon sıktım.
example_translation: I squeezed lemon to add seasoning to the food.
notes: Front vowel word: çeşniler. 'Çeşni katmak' (to add flavor). Persian origin.

example_translation: I prepared tomato sauce for the pasta.
notes: Back vowel word: soslar. From French 'sauce'. 'Sos hazırlamak' (to prepare sauce).

example_sentence: Eti bir gece önceden marine ettim.
example_translation: I marinated the meat the night before.
notes: Compound verb: marine (marinated) + etmek. From French 'mariner'.

example_sentence: Bu tarif dört porsiyon için yeterli.
example_translation: This recipe is enough for four servings.
notes: Back vowel word: porsiyonlar. From French 'portion'. Common at restaurants.

example_translation: My father is a civil engineer.
notes: Front vowel word: mühendisler. 'Mühendislik' (engineering). Arabic origin.

example_translation: I need to meet with my lawyer.
notes: Back vowel word: avukatlar. Consonant change: avukat → avukatı. From Italian 'avvocato'.

example_sentence: Ünlü mimar Sinan birçok eser bıraktı.
example_translation: The famous architect Sinan left behind many works.
notes: Back vowel word: mimarlar. 'Mimarlık' (architecture). Mimar Sinan is Turkey's most famous architect.

example_translation: Our accountant prepared the tax return.
notes: From 'muhasebe' (accounting) + -ci agent suffix. Front vowel word: muhasebeciler.

example_translation: Young entrepreneurs are presenting new ideas.
notes: From 'girişim' (enterprise/initiative) + -ci. Front vowel word: girişimciler.

example_translation: I started seeing a psychologist.
notes: Back vowel word: psikologlar. 'Psikoloji' (psychology). Awareness growing in Turkey.

example_translation: We need a translator at the meeting.
notes: From 'çevirmek' (to translate/turn) + -men agent suffix. Front vowel word: çevirmenler.

example_translation: The pharmacist recommended this medicine.
notes: From 'eczane' (pharmacy) root + -cı agent suffix. Back vowel: eczacılar.

example_translation: Journalists followed the press conference.
notes: From 'gazete' (newspaper) + -ci agent suffix. Front vowel word: gazeteciler.

example_translation: I got a promotion last month.
notes: Front vowel word: terfiler. 'Terfi almak/etmek' (to get promoted). Arabic origin.

example_translation: My salary is deposited at the beginning of the month.
notes: Back vowel word: maaşlar. 'Maaş almak' (to receive salary), 'asgari ücret' (minimum wage).

example_translation: The company is hiring new employees.
notes: Compound: işe (to work, dative) + almak (to take). 'İşe alım' (hiring/recruitment).

example_translation: The manager resigned yesterday.
notes: Compound verb: istifa (resignation) + etmek. Arabic origin. 'İstifa mektubu' (resignation letter).

example_sentence: Bu alanda beş yıllık deneyimim var.
example_translation: I have five years of experience in this field.
notes: Front vowel word: deneyimler. 'Deneyimli' (experienced), 'deneyimsiz' (inexperienced).

example_translation: I need to update my CV.
notes: Compound: öz (self) + geçmiş (past). Literally 'self-history'. Front vowel word.

example_translation: I have a job interview tomorrow.
notes: Compound: iş (work) + görüşmesi (its meeting, with possessive). Common collocation.

example_sentence: Yaz stajımı bir teknoloji şirketinde yaptım.
example_translation: I did my summer internship at a technology company.
notes: Back vowel word: stajlar. 'Stajyer' (intern), 'staj yapmak' (to do an internship). From French 'stage'.

example_translation: Our manager cancelled the meeting.
notes: From 'yönetmek' (to manage) + -ici agent suffix. Front vowel word: yöneticiler.

example_translation: We met with the financial consultant.
notes: From 'danışmak' (to consult) + -man agent suffix. Back vowel word: danışmanlar.

example_translation: You should visit the museums in Istanbul.
notes: Front vowel word: müzeler. Topkapı Palace and Hagia Sophia are famous Turkish museums.

example_translation: Interest in performing arts is increasing.
notes: Compound: sahne (stage) + sanatları (its arts, with possessive plural). Covers theater, dance, music.

example_translation: The use of renewable energy is increasing.
notes: From 'yenilenmek' (to be renewed) + -ebilir (ability). Long but regular Turkish suffix chain.

example_translation: The marine ecosystem is under threat.
notes: Front vowel word: ekosistemler. 'Ekosistemin dengesi' (balance of the ecosystem).

example_translation: Would you subscribe to the channel?
notes: Front vowel word: aboneler. 'Abone olmak' (to subscribe). Used for YouTube, newspapers, services.

example_translation: The inspector audited the factory.
notes: Front vowel word: müfettişler. Arabic origin. 'Denetim' (inspection/audit).

example_translation: We finally reached a compromise on something.
notes: Reciprocal form with -ış. Related: uzlaşma (compromise/consensus). Back vowel word.

example_translation: Building empathy strengthens relationships.
notes: Front vowel word: empatiler. 'Empati kurmak' (to empathize). Increasingly used in modern Turkish.

example_translation: I like watching athletics competitions.
notes: Front vowel word. Turkey has produced notable athletes in this field.

example_translation: I cooked the meat on the grill.
notes: Back vowel word: ızgaralar. 'Izgara yapmak' (to grill). Turkish cuisine is famous for grilled meats.

example_sentence: Siber güvenlik her geçen gün daha önemli hale geliyor.
example_translation: Cybersecurity is becoming more important every day.
notes: Compound: siber (cyber) + güvenlik (security). Growing field in Turkey.
